verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models, and users confirm downloaded models are easy to manage with 'ollama pull' and 'ollama rm'. Model management is even singled out as an area where Ollama beats llama.cpp. Nothing in the evidence shows saved-prompt management, per-model configuration, or a single unified place for all three. missing for 10: saved prompts management, per-model configuration management, a unified single interface covering models/prompts/configs, first-party docs detailing model management.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
One 'ollama pull' and it's available. Underwhelming? 'ollama rm'.
llama.cpp does almost everything ollama does better except model management.
